subject: SIG questionnaire: BrightPoint evidence sprint and handoff cadence

From: Tom Reynolds <t.reynolds@brightpointhealth.com>
To: jordan_blake
Date: 2027-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire — target July 1

Jordan,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. We're consolidating SIG responses across our procurement team and need Redwood's completed SIG by EOD July 1 so legal can finish review the week after. Can you confirm who on your side will own the technical controls and whether you can provide artifacts for encryption, access controls, and logging (syslog/SIEM screenshots or flow descriptions)?

Also: any chance you can share a short timeline (milestones) for the items you can deliver this week vs next? Our CISO will want to see a realistic handoff cadence.

Tom

Head of Security Operations
BrightPoint Health
+t: (415) 555-0191
From: jordan_blake
To: marissa_cole, ben_carter, stephanie_nguyen
Date: 2027-06-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG questionnaire — target July 1

Team — forwarding BrightPoint's note. Deadline is tight (7/1). Can Marissa lead the responses and artifact assembly? Ben can you confirm the encryption and logging artifacts? Steph, please coordinate the hosting/network controls section and availability windows for a quick call if needed.

High-level plan suggestion:
- Today (6/18): assign owners + gather existing artifacts
- 6/19: internal review & fill SIG sheet
- 6/20: consolidate and send to BrightPoint for quick review

I'll own the final delivery and follow-up with Tom. If anything blocks, escalate to me immediately.

Sounds good — I'll take owner for the SIG responses and artifact zip. Quick asks: please send any existing certs, SOC2 excerpt, or architecture diagrams you want included. I'm attaching a short roadmap template to track per-question owners (SIG_Roadmap_Template.xlsx).

I'll populate the control-level answers for: governance, vendor mgmt, incident response, data classification. Ben — can you attach the encryption at-rest key certs and an example KMS policy? Steph — ping me availability for a 20-min sync at 2pm PT tomorrow (6/19) so we can do a single pass.

Attachment: SIG_Roadmap_Template.xlsx (stub)

Marissa Cole
Security Programs Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
From: ben_carter
To: marissa_cole, jordan_blake
Date: 2027-06-19T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG owner + artifacts

Attached: encryption cert and short note on key management. I've pulled the cert used for our GCP KMS integration (enc-cert-2025.pdf) and a short README describing where to find historical key rotation logs in our audit bucket. For logging/SIEM, we can provide sanitized sample alerts and a syslog ingestion diagram — will prepare a sanitized screenshot by EOD 6/19.

Notes:
- Encryption at rest: GCP CMEK via KMS, rotation every 12 months (rotation job logs retained in audit-bucket/redwood/keys)
- Access controls: RBAC via our identity provider; mapping doc will be in the SIG zip

Ben Carter
